ruleDefinitions.name: Microsoft Excel Add-In Loaded From Uncommon Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Microsoft Excel loading an Add-In (.xll) file from an uncommon location Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$") AND (ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*")) AND ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\.xll$"))
